title: Hotel check-in details
description: Send check-in time, address and arrival instructions before a hotel stay. Utility WhatsApp template that cuts front-desk calls.
notes: Send 24 hours before arrival. Practical info like late arrival and parking keeps it transactional.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we look forward to welcoming you tomorrow! Check-in starts at *{{checkin_time}}* at {{address}}. Reply here if you expect to arrive late and we will hold your room.
